keywords: 原生 AA 让隐私无缝
summary: 以太坊基金会发布新的 EF Mandate，Vitalik 称这是对过去几个月方向的澄清。derekchiang 提议简化 EIP-8141 批准位，让账户可直接把 TXPARAM 结果传给 APPROVE。EliBenSasson 概括 ZK 负责隐私、原生 AA 负责让隐私无缝。

items.title: 以太坊基金会博客：以太坊的承诺，介绍 EF Mandate
items.title_en: EF blog: The Promise of Ethereum, Introducing the EF Mandate

items.title: VitalikButerin：这是新的 EF Mandate，内容沿着过去几个月的方向，但仍值得明确说明
items.title_en: VitalikButerin: this is the new EF Mandate, along the lines of recent months but still worth making explicit

items.title: EIP-8141：简化批准位，账户无需自行处理
items.note: （derekchiang）提交：账户可直接把 TXPARAM 的结果传给 APPROVE 来确定批准范围，也不排除使用其他逻辑。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: simplify approval bits so accounts do not have to manipulate them
items.note_en: (derekchiang), submitted: accounts can pass the TXPARAM result directly to APPROVE to set the approval scope, without ruling out other logic.

items.title: EIP-8141：修正位索引
items.note: （fjl）提交并合并；EIP-7906：改用操作码而非交易类型或预编译（forshtat）提交并合并。
items.note_en: (fjl), submitted and merged; EIP-7906: use opcodes instead of transaction types or precompiles (forshtat), submitted and merged.

items.title: EIP-7906：改用操作码而非交易类型或预编译
items.note: EIP-8141：修正位索引（fjl）提交并合并；EIP-7906：改用操作码而非交易类型或预编译（forshtat）提交并合并。
items.title_en: EIP-7906: use opcodes instead of transaction types or precompiles
items.note_en: EIP-8141: fix bit indices (fjl), submitted and merged; EIP-7906: use opcodes instead of transaction types or precompiles (forshtat), submitted and merged.

summary_en: The Ethereum Foundation published its new EF Mandate, which Vitalik called a clarification of the direction of recent months. derekchiang proposed simplifying EIP-8141 approval bits so accounts can pass the TXPARAM result straight to APPROVE. EliBenSasson summed up: ZK builds privacy, native AA makes it seamless.
